info.name: CCFC Mobile API
info.description: All active member routes in routes/api.php. Import and select the companion environment. Set base_url, member credentials and device type. Login saves app_access_token automatically. Authorization uses the raw token. OTP requests send messages. Send requests individually: running the entire collection against production can change passwords, request account deletion, submit profile changes and record payments. Examples reflect local source; live behavior has not been verified.

request.description: Source: routes/api.php, AuthController::index. Legacy paginated member list; response contains member data. No authentication check in this controller.

exec: function findToken(v) { if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return; if (typeof v.app_access_token === "string" && v.app_access_token) return v.app_access_token; for (const child of Object.values(v)) { const token = findToken(child); if (token) return token; } }
pm.test("Login returned an app access token", () => pm.expect(token).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty);

function findToken(v) { if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return; if (typeof v.app_access_token === "string" && v.app_access_token) return v.app_access_token; for (const child of Object.values(v)) { const token = findToken(child); if (token) return token; } }
pm.test("Login returned an app access token", () => pm.expect(token).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty);
